logp.method_description: The lipophilicity/hydrophobicity (log Pow) value of 1–4 was determined using the shake-flask method followed by UV–vis analysis at room temperature. (82-84) Here, n-octanol was the organic phase, and Milli-Q water was the aqueous phase. Equal quantities of both phases were mixed and kept saturated for 24 h. After saturation, 50 μM tested compounds were loaded into the organic phase. The drug-loaded organic phase was again mixed with the aqueous phase (with the same volume) in a conical flask, and the flask was kept for shaking in a thermostatic shaker at 25 °C. The UV–vis absorption spectra of compounds in the aqueous and organic phases were determined by UV–vis spectroscopy. logPow = log10(Corg / Caq). where Corg and Caq are the concentrations of the vanadium compounds in the organic and aqueous phases, respectively.
